basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and tech enthusiast hailing from the Pacific Northwest. I spend my days working as a network engineer, and my nights exploring virtual worlds. When I'm not gaming, you can find me experimenting with new spray paint techniques or planning visits to intentional communities around the country. I'm single, and I usually browse Reddit during evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in IT for over five years. My expertise in gaming comes from years of playing and exploring different genres, particularly tactical shooters. I've self-taught various DIY skills, especially related to spray painting, through online tutorials and community forums.
